title: Consistency Check work items v0.1
description: What the deterministic helper hands the consistency-check agent: one item per conflict candidate, carrying both readings and their exact evidence, plus the facts the helper can establish without judgement (whether the field is decision-bearing, whether each side is evidenced). It deliberately holds NO verdict field -- deciding whether two readings are a real contradiction is the agent's work, and a prepared answer would make that decision by suggestion. The candidate_digest binds each item to the exact candidate content it was built from, so a verdict written against one version of a candidate cannot be registered against another.

claim_analysis_sha256.description: Digest of the claim_analysis_result.json these items were prepared from.

candidate_digest.description: Digest over the candidate and the observations it cites. Changes whenever any cited reading changes, which is what makes a stale verdict detectable rather than silently applied to different content.

decision_bearing.description: Whether the routing config marks this field critical_conflict_field. A fact about the configuration, not a verdict: the agent still decides whether THIS disagreement matters.
